actions: On UM760 with a reachable Sunshine host, start Moonlight through MediaStation (MEDIASTATION_DEV_HARNESS=1, MEDIASTATION_HARNESS_MOONLIGHT, tile moonlight-pc) and confirm the handshake completes and the stream is visible (AC1).
If the hang persists, attach the appLaunch and appLaunchStage log entries plus the log of a manual start so the ticket can end as a Source conflict (AC5).
